YrelVindicationLightOfKarabor.name: Light of Karabor
YrelVindicationLightOfKarabor.description: Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 45%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased to 90%.

YrelDauntless.name: Dauntless
YrelDauntless.description: Casting a Basic Ability grants Yrel 35 Physical Armor for 2.5 seconds.

YrelMaraadsInsight.name: Maraad's Insight
YrelMaraadsInsight.description: After damaging an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack heals her for 140 (+4% per level).

YrelAvengingWrathAegisOfLight.name: Aegis of Light
YrelAvengingWrathAegisOfLight.description: Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 30 Armor for 4 seconds.

YrelDivinePurposeGiftOfTheNaaru.name: Gift of the Naaru
YrelDivinePurposeGiftOfTheNaaru.description: Divine Purpose heals the lowest Health nearby allied Hero other than Yrel for 275 (+4% per level).

YrelHandOfFreedom.name: Hand of Freedom
YrelHandOfFreedom.description: Grant an allied Hero 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and remove all Slows and Roots from them.

YrelRighteousHammerRighteousMomentum.name: Righteous Momentum
YrelRighteousHammerRighteousMomentum.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while Channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.

YrelAvengingWrathHolyAvenger.name: Holy Avenger
YrelAvengingWrathHolyAvenger.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Avenging Wrath at maximum charge deals 25% more damage and reduces its cooldown to 1 second.

YrelDivineSteed.name: Divine Steed
YrelDivineSteed.description: Mounting is instant and grants 60% Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds.

YrelArdentDefender.name: Ardent Defender
YrelArdentDefender.description: Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.

YrelSacredGround.name: Sacred Ground
YrelSacredGround.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

YrelVindicationAldorPeacekeeper.name: Aldor Peacekeeper
YrelVindicationAldorPeacekeeper.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Vindication at maximum charge deal 40% less damage for 3 seconds.

YrelAvengingWrathRepentance.name: Repentance
YrelAvengingWrathRepentance.description: Increase Avenging Wrath's Slow by 25% and duration by 0.75 seconds.

YrelVelensChosen.name: Velen's Chosen
YrelVelensChosen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability at maximum charge grants 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.

YrelRighteousHammerTemplarsVerdict.name: Templar's Verdict
YrelRighteousHammerTemplarsVerdict.description: Righteous Hammer reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 20 for 4 seconds and deals bonus damage equal to 7% of their maximum Health.

YrelDivinePurposeDivineFavor.name: Divine Favor
YrelDivinePurposeDivineFavor.description: Casting a Basic Ability reduces the cooldown of Divine Purpose by 2.5 seconds.

YrelHolyWrath.name: Holy Wrath
YrelHolyWrath.description: After casting a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack splashes for 35% increased damage around the target.

YrelArdentDefenderWordOfGlory.name: Word of Glory
YrelArdentDefenderWordOfGlory.description: Increase the amount that Yrel heals from damage received from 50% to 75%. Ardent Defender heals nearby allied Heroes for 100% of the healing received by Yrel.

YrelSacredGroundHallowedGround.name: Hallowed Ground
YrelSacredGroundHallowedGround.description: Casting Avenging Wrath while inside Sacred Ground moves Sacred Ground to Yrel's location upon landing.

YrelBubbleHearth.name: Bubble Hearth
YrelBubbleHearth.description: After 1 second, Yrel becomes Invulnerable and casts Hearthstone. Cannot be canceled.

YrelSeraphim.name: Seraphim
YrelSeraphim.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds.
